speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting; this is a serious finding that requires us to determine if the obstruction is in the duodenum, jejunum, or ileum. To begin our assessment, please tell me how many hours after birth these symptoms started and if you have passed meconium?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.
